about.title: Crafting Digital Experiences with AI
about.bio: I'm a Senior Frontend Engineer with 5+ years building production web applications across healthcare, edtech, e-commerce, and enterprise software. Based in Bangalore, I specialise in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and AI application development — from streaming chat interfaces to complete RAG pipelines running on local GPU.

projects.subtitle: Real applications built and deployed in production.

items.title: Next.js AI SDK Playground
items.description: Production AI application exploring multiple AI patterns. Built with streaming chat (token-by-token rendering), multi-modal inputs, structured data extraction, and real-time token usage tracking. Includes production-grade rate limiting with Upstash Redis.

items.title: RAG Document Pipeline
items.description: Complete Retrieval-Augmented Generation system. Loads documents, splits them into chunks, creates embeddings, and stores them in FAISS — all running locally on an RTX 4060 GPU. Zero API costs.

items.title: E-Consult Healthcare Platform
items.description: Real-time doctor-patient consultation platform with video calling, live appointment booking, and WebSocket-based instant messaging.

items.title: Edprime ERP System
items.description: Enterprise education management platform with library module, automated CRUD code generation tool, and reusable component architecture.
